title: Borland's alleged classified drawing of a hieroglyph-like symbol
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Borland's alleged classified drawing of a hieroglyph-like symbol, about recent (2020s) at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Third thing that was told to me by ODNI is that Dylan do did a drawing of like a hieroglyph.
And then he also said that you drew pictures for the ODNI and one of those pictures was a hieroglyph.
tellings.difference: The host passes on Corbell's claim, saying the drawings were made for the ODNI rather than in ICIG testimony.

as_told.title: ODNI's hieroglyph-on-a-UFO claim leaked to Jeremy Corbell

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who makes UFO documentaries, said on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2026 that people at the ODNI, the office that oversees all US spy agencies, told him something about a witness named Dylan Borland. According to Corbell, Borland made a drawing of something like a hieroglyph, and the drawing was kept classified. If true, it would mean a government witness had recorded writing or symbols from something not made by people.
